title: Under Ninja Manga Goes on 4-Week Hiatus
content:
This year's 52nd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that Kengo Hanazawa 's Under Ninja manga will go on a four-week hiatus. The manga will return in the magazine's combined fourth and fifth issue of 2027, which will actually ship on December 28.

Manga publisher Denpa is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the series:

A high school loner is given the part-time job of a lifetime as a modern day ninja tasked to perform international assassinations. After World War II, Allied Command in Japan developed a new agency to help manage terrorism and violence within the Pacific region. The agency was staffed with ninja and they were initially tasked to handle domestic affairs. Eventuallt that program grew to its current form, managing 20,000 ninja across a range of domestic and international affairs. One of those ninja happen to be Kurō. The seventeen-year-old high school loser is now poised to be the next line of defense against a potential surge in foreign assassins invading Tokyo.

Hanazawa ( I am a Hero ) launched the manga in Weekly Young Magazine in July 2018. Kodansha published the manga's 18th compiled book volume on August 6.

The manga inspired a television anime, which premiered in October 2023. The anime starred Taito Ban as Kurō Kumogakure and Tarusuke Shingaki as Katō.

The manga also inspired a live-action film that premiered in Japan in January 2025. The film's announced world premiere screening in Los Angeles was canceled due to the state of emergency declared in California during the wildfires in January 2025.

title: Exoprimal Game Ends Service in September 2027
content:
CAPCOM announced on Wednesday that its Exoprimal team-based action game will end service on September 29, 2027.

Sales of Survival Pass Premium Tiers ended on Tuesday. The game, DLC, and all other tie-in products will be delisted from stores on March 30.

The game will no longer be playable after the end of service.

The game launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in July 2023. The game was available on launch day on Xbox Game Pass.

Set in the near-future of 2040, Exoprimal casts players as soldiers armed with powered armor exosuits fighting against waves of dinosaurs, who come to our world through portals known as "vortexes." The artificial intelligence Leviathan is able to predict where vortexes will emerge, and will guide players throughout the game. Players have to stem the tide of a variety of rampaging dinosaurs, and can take on different roles in combat depending on their exosuit, which they can switch out of freely even while in combat.

The game featured collaborations with other CAPCOM titles such as Mega Man and Street Fighter 6 .

title: Melty Blood:Twi-Lumina 2D Fighter Game's New Trailer Confirms Crossplay
content:
Type-Moon 's Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina 2D fighter game revealed new features as well as crossplay capability in its main trailer on Wednesday.

TYPE-MOON describes the game:

MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray! A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

Kinoko Nasu and TYPE-MOON are credited for the original work, French Bread is developing the game, and Aniplex / Aniplex of America are publishing the game.

The game will launch on April 22 for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PC via Steam .

The game will have voiceover in Japanese only, and text available in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, and Portuguese.

TYPE-MOON and French Bread's Melty Blood: Type Lumina 2D fighting game launched for Switch, PS4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in September 2021. The game has text in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Korean. The game uses the Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon- remake game as a base for its worldview, and is a completely new work. The game features more than 10 characters, including Shiki Tohno, Arcueid Brunestud, Akita Tohno, and Ciel. All characters have 10 color variations, as well as their own story.

Metarogu's MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA Piece in Paradise spinoff manga launched on the Type-Moon Comic Ace website in 2022, and ended in December 2025.

title: Bandai Card Games Launches Digimon Alysion Game
content:
Bandai Card Games released its Digimon Alysion mobile card game on Wednesday. The game is available for iOS and Android devices in 183 territories.

The free-to-play game features online card battles. It features an original story that takes place in the same world as the Digimon Liberator vertical-scrolling webcomic , which launched in April 2024.

The game was initially announced during Digimon Con in March 2025.

The Digimon Story Time Stranger game launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in October 2025. The game launched for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on July 10. The Switch 2 version features improved graphics as well as performance mode and quality mode.

Bandai Namco Entertainment announced in March a new mobile game titled Digimon UP . The game launched on July 15. Bandai Namco describes that the game's concept built around "a Digimon journey that moves with your life."

title: Nobunaga's Ambition Series Gets New Game Next March
content:
Koei Tecmo announced on Wednesday that Nobunaga no Yabō: Hishou ( Nobunaga's Ambition: Hishou or Soaring), a new game in its Nobunaga's Ambition game franchise, will launch for the PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Windows via Steam on March 12. The game's Steam page reports that it "features a new Warring States experience focused on justice, a domestic affairs system that promotes city development, and the series' first story mode."

There will be unique bonus scenarios for early physical pre-orders and digital pre-orders of the game. The Treasure Box version of the game includes a bonus scenario, artbook, castle data, and original soundtrack.

Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening Complete Edition launched for the Nintendo Switch 2 in June 2025, as part of the Switch 2's launch lineup. Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening Complete Edition includes the DLC from the original game, as well as six new scenarios with Decisive Battles. The original game launched in the west digitally for PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam worldwide in July 2023. That release was itself an updated version of the original Nobunaga no Yabō: Shinsei game , which launched in Japan in July 2022, after a delay from 2021.

title: 'Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2' Unveils Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Buncololi ’s Sasaki to Pii-chan ( Sasaki and Peeps ) reveals additional cast on Wednesday. The anime series premiered on October 7 and is currently airing on AT-X, Tokyo MX and BS Nippon Television, with the first episode broadcasting as a one-hour special.

Cast Magical Pink: Inori Minase ( Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ) Magical Red: Sumire Uesaka ( Urusei Yatsura (2022) ) Magical Blue: Akira Sekine ( Nisekoi ) Magical Yellow: Konomi Kohara ( Star☆Twinkle Precure )

Yuushi Ibe ( Tearmoon Teikoku Monogatari ) is directing the second season at SILVER LINK , with Yamato Oouchi ( Soredemo Ayumu wa Yosetekuru episode director) serving as assistant director. Deko Akao ( Buta no Liver wa Kanetsu Shiro ) is handling the series composition. Saori Nakashiki ( Kekkon Yubiwa Monogatari ) is designing the characters.

Produced by SILVER LINK , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Winter 2024. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles and later streamed an English dub.

Buncololi began penning the novel on the Kakuyomu website in December 2018. Kadokawa began publishing the series under its MF Bunko J label in January 2021, featuring illustrations by Kantoku ( Hentai Ouji to Warawanai Neko. ). The 14th volume was released on October 23.

Shounen Ace Plus began serializing a manga adaptation by Oshou Pureji in January 2021. Kadokawa published the sixth volume on June 26.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga in English and released the tenth light novel volume on August 11, with the eleventh light novel volume scheduled for release on April 13, 2027. The fifth manga volume went on sale on October 27.

News Submitted by red1130

title: Sentimental Graffiti Remake Game Listed on March 25
content:
The Animate retail chain is listing Sentimental Graffiti Remake (written as Sentimental Graffiti Re ), Entergram's remake of NEC Interchannel 's classic dating simulation game Sentimental Graffiti , for release on PlayStation 5 and Switch on March 25.

The remake aims to improve the original's graphics, mechanics, and other elements to modern game standards. Part of the original game's scenario will be "adjusted to fit the modern times" while keeping the character designs and other elements basically unchanged.

The remake features a new cast. Similar to the original game's casting, the new game's staff held open auditions for six of the heroines, which accepted applicants until July 31.

NEC Interchannel released the original Sentimental Graffiti game on the Sega Saturn console in Japan in 1998, and later ported it to Windows and PlayStation . The game inspired the 12-episode Sentimental Journey television series from Sunrise and director Kazuyoshi Katayama ( Appleseed , The Big O , Those Who Hunt Elves ) in 1998. Media Blasters released the series on DVD in 2004.

title: Live-Action 'The Long Summer of August 31' Series Trailer Unveils Cast, Staff, Disney+ Streaming, January 8 Debut
content:
The official website for the live-action series of Ikkado Ito 's The Long Summer of August 31 ( August 31 no Long Summer ) manga unveiled a special trailer and key visual for the series on Thursday. The video announces the series' cast, staff, Disney+ streaming, and January 8 premiere date.

ACEes group member Ryūga Satō ( Tomodachi Game R4 , The High School Heroes , left in image above) plays Takaya Suzuki, while Runa Takashima ( Tore!, Tokyo Taxi , right) plays Kana Takagi.

Tatsunori Satō, Kōji Ono, and Meru Tsukada are directing the series, with scripts by Moral . Moto Kawabe is composing the music.

The series will premiere on TV Tokyo , TV Osaka , TV Aichi , TV Setouchi , TV Hokkaido , and TVQ on January 8 at 24:52 (effectively, January 9 at 12:52 a.m.), and will run on BS TV Tokyo on January 11. Each episode will stream on Disney+ after its television premiere. Although the video above does not confirm that the streaming will be worldwide, producer Kanata Nakajima said in a message that he looks forward to everyone in the world watching it on Disney+ .

Seven Seas Entertainment and Kodansha 's K MANGA service publish the manga physically and digitally, respectively. Seven Seas describes the story:

Caught in an endlessly repeating August 31st, high schoolers Suzuki Takaya and Takagi Kana are the only ones who remember each loop. The likely cause? Suzuki's unfinished summer mission to secure a girlfriend and lose his virginity—the ultimate teenage goal. A hilarious yet heartfelt time-loop comedy!

Ito launched the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in 2023. Kodansha published the manga's 13th compiled book volume on August 21. Seven Seas published the manga's seventh volume physically on November 10.

The manga is also inspiring an upcoming television anime by SHAFT .

Ito launched the I'm Not Meat: Get Your Filthy Paws Off Me! ( Boku wa Oniku janai ) manga in Shogakukan 's Monthly Spirits magazine in July 2020. Shogakukan published the manga's third and final compiled book volume in December 2021. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga under its Ghost Ship imprint, and published the manga's third and final volume in English in May 2023.

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest Fall 2026 Anime Exposes the Real Problem Behind One-Punch Man
content:
J.C. Staff isn’t the problem behind One-Punch Man ‘s disaster, as the studio’s latest anime, currently airing weekly on Crunchyroll, is doing wonders with its animation. Fans often blame J.C. Staff for the decline in quality that plagued the second and third seasons of One-Punch Man . While the second season surprised fans with how much worse it looked compared to the first, the third season, despite taking six years to arrive, somehow looked even worse. It was natural for fans to point their fingers at the studio in charge. However, J.C. Staff has been making anime for four decades now and has crafted some great-looking series.

The anime proving this is Overgeared , which is currently airing weekly on Crunchyroll. While its earlier episodes already demonstrated that J.C. Staff is more than capable of producing a decent action anime, the latest episode delivered one of the coolest fight sequences of 2026, lasting around six to seven minutes. The animation quality reaches its peak throughout this sequence, delivering the kind of spectacular action usually expected from a high-budget anime movie. So, why couldn’t One-Punch Man receive the same treatment ? The answer is actually quite simple: no anime studio cared enough about the One-Punch Man anime, and the blame goes back to Madhouse itself as well.

Crunchyroll’s Overgeared Proves J.C. Staff Was Never to Blame for One-Punch Man ‘s Disaster

Madhouse produced the first season of the One-Punch Man anime without a permanent staff allocated to the production, instead relying on a team of freelancers working under director Shingo Natsume. However, the studio didn’t continue with the second season because of scheduling conflicts, as the director was tied to several other projects. This eventually led Madhouse to drop the project altogether. The blame ultimately lies with Bandai Namco and the production committee, which wanted to capitalize on the success of the first season without waiting for the original team to return.

This eventually led to J.C. Staff taking over the anime under strict budget and time constraints. This highlights how the disaster of the anime’s second season stemmed from the fact that the project was never given priority, with the production committee neither waiting for Madhouse’s schedule to align nor giving J.C. Staff enough time or budget. The result was disastrous second and third seasons, both products of a production that was never given enough care. With the emergence of Overgeared , fans shouldn’t expect the upcoming part of One-Punch Man Season 3 to look any better .

Considering how both parts of the season appear to have been produced under almost identical production guidelines, as evidenced by the same edited poster from Part 1 being reused to promote Part 2, there is little reason to expect an improvement. The fact remains that One-Punch Man was never given enough attention by the production committee from the start, as it never even had a permanent staff at Madhouse.

Had things been different, One-Punch Man , even under J.C. Staff, could have emerged as a series as great as, or even better than, Overgeared , which is being hailed as Crunchyroll’s hottest Fall 2026 anime , delivering action that only a handful of anime can match. How are you feeling about Overgeared so far compared to releases like One-Punch Man ? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments.
